rdfs:label: MediaTypeOrExtent
rdfs:comment: A media type or extent — superclass of dcterms:MediaType (incl. FileFormat, PhysicalMedium) and SizeOrDuration; the range of `urn:solid:format`.
notes: Type of values for `urn:solid:format`: either a media type (IANA registry, file format) or a size/duration. Rarely typed directly — usually you pick a more specific subclass (`FileFormat`, `MediaType`, `SizeOrDuration`); the example shows a FileFormat value.

history.note: Comment no longer calls it a union class; example typed with the FileFormat subclass.
